title: Want to love them, but don’t
text: Want to love them, but don’t. My 5 and 6 year old both LOVE Star Wars. I was so excited to try these out and thought we would all love them, but we just don’t. First and foremost, they are weird sizes. They are really too big. The “sandwich” one is more like a Ziploc quart sized bag, which is WAY too big for any sort of snack for my kids. I tried sending goldfish in one and my son said he didn’t want to use the bag again. The large one is huge, I’m really not sure what I would use it for. Maybe if I was packing 4 sandwiches all together for my family, but that rarely happens. Second, the designs are really just ok. They are not super bright or vivid and just kinda blend in to the bag. Both of those combined with how crazy expensive they are, I would pass on these. I saw the same designs yesterday on glass Pyrex at Costco for $20 for 4 jars with lids, and I thought about it for a moment but then ended up skipping those as well because of the designs.
